{{Quote|I was looking for a way to get some information out of a certain Vernol—a real mopakhead named Shulf’aa. He’s a merchant over in&mdash;|Den Dhur|<ref name="sos" />}}
'''Shulf'aa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Vernol]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] and art dealer. He owned two sculptures of famed light sculptor [[Ves Volette]], which he obtained through illegal channels. Former journalist [[Den Dhur]] was arrested for impersonating a police officer while interrogating Shulf'aa for information.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Anyway, so I pressed Shulf’aa, threatened to take him in for attempting to vend stolen goods, and he offered me a bribe to keep quiet about the whole matter. I told him that I would&mdash;but that he could keep his money, in return for the name of the individual who provided him with the goods.|Den Dhur|<ref name="sos" />}}
Some time after he illegally came into possession of two works of art by the light artist [[Ves Volette]], he was murdered. The rising prices caused Shulf'aa to hope for a high profit, so he immediately understood all price increases. As a result, however, he made the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] reporter [[Den Dhur]] attention, which in the murder case of the Caamasi determined. He went to see him and threatened to expose Shulfaas' illegal business if he did not cooperate with him. Then Shulf'aa agreed to give him the name of the individual who stole the light sculptures and passed them on to him, a Nuknog named [[Spa Fon]]. Later, Shulf'aa filed a complaint with the sector police against Dhur, which did nothing because the police prefect Pol Haus was a member of [[Whiplash]].<ref name="sos" />
